resumo:
Software engineer building SaaS for river transportation and port management in the Amazon. I am part of the team that designed and keeps developing an ecosystem connecting ticket e-commerce, port management, financial control and physical access control, serving shipping companies, travel agencies, ports and passengers. I currently balance my main role at W3 Companhia with freelance projects, delivering consistent technical work.

Key contributions:
• Modernized sales processes, creating a more efficient experience for sellers and buyers.
• Faster, more efficient reports, especially over large data volumes.
• Security and consistency improvements that reduced anomalies and increased software reliability.
• Strategic new features that increased operational efficiency and revenue.
afinidades: Optimizing and solving complex SQL queries
Coding challenges focused on logic and algorithms
Analyzing and refactoring code for performance

experiencias.empresa: O Mentor Concursos, Taboão da Serra/SP
experiencias.descricao:
• Restructured the tool architecture of Agente Águia's AI chat: **semantic search, flashcard generation and study summaries**.
• Built Agente Águia's question module: question and exam bank, **automated AI extraction pipeline** and LLM-generated teaching comments.
• Integrated Agente Águia's question bank into Mentor: free-study sessions with filters and **topics pre-selected from the student's history**.

• Built **Boto**, the FIAM team's AI assistant that answers natural-language questions about projects, balances and payments, with **NL2ORM security layers and an AST allowlist** on its queries, validated by an adversarial test suite.
• Implemented **AI document analysis** for requests: checks that attachments match the request (with OCR) and opens a pending issue for the beneficiary when something doesn't add up.
• Created "Analyze and fill": AI reads the **contract and work plan** and fills in the project record, including its budget lines.
• Built the creation and approval flow for financial requests (**13 types**: per diems, grants, purchases, reimbursements, advances, etc.), with automatic balance control per budget line.
• Built bank reconciliation (statement import, bulk reconciliation and accounting export) and **direct integration with Banco do Brasil**, including investments and redemptions via its Funds API, plus Sicredi.
• Implemented the institutional integration API with **key rotation with zero downtime**, management reports in PDF/Excel and automated document backups.

• Architected TechRios (SaaS ERP for river transportation): restructured the trips, routes and data pipeline modules, driving +36.7% in transactions vs. 2024.
• Built Porto Fácil, a port management REST API consumed by multiple systems and physical turnstiles, cutting fee reconciliation from hours to minutes.
• Helped restructure Yjara Viagens (ticket e-commerce): API redesign, data modeling and services. Went live in Jun/2025 with +44% in transaction volume.
• Embedded AI into TechRios operations: sales assistance based on the passenger's history and an **in-house MCP server** for natural-language business queries.
• Evolved **W3Zap**, an omnichannel CRM (WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger) based on Ticketz: official WhatsApp API, template campaigns, **AI agents in automations** and voice calls with multi-user management.
• Integrated external systems such as **Dropbox, BP-e (SEFAZ), Safe2Pay and Sicredi**.
• Technologies: PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node, Vue, Laravel, Inertia, CSS, MySQL.

• Built full-stack web features with PHP and JavaScript.
• Optimized database queries and structures for efficiency.
• Technologies: PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript, jQuery, Ajax, Node, Vue, Laravel, Inertia, CSS, MySQL.
